existing_channel: Existing GRN draft and catalog administration; no request engine

steps.action: Search active items; reuse same meaning for new brand/model. Otherwise post without a Finance Code (standard tag); nothing blocks the receipt.

steps.actor: existing national catalog publisher with Finance/Administration evidence where required
steps.action: Choose group/subgroup; review exact supported Finance change through existing national process.

Lock finance-code:item scope GG; allocate the next unused item number in the whole group (01..99) checking held/active/retired rows; II runs across the group, not per subgroup. New hierarchy starts with its first item.
Publish approved item/authority reference. Optional existing UNSPSC association. Preserve payload, expiry and durable one-use execution.

steps.actor: product-type owner (national publisher for global types, company editor for company types)
steps.action: Optionally set the new code as the product-type default. Future receipts inherit it; units already issued with standard tags keep them (D-05).

rules.new_subgroup: Same counter table with scope GG; first item created together
rules.new_group: Same counter table with root scope; first item created together
rules.unspsc: Optional existing code; must equal the product type's single UNSPSC when used as its default; do not invent official codes
rules.exhaustion: Warn from 90 used item numbers in a group; refuse at 99; receiving continues with standard tags; D-08 Option A (per-subgroup numbering for that group) recommended for authority approval; Option B new 3-digit-item format only if A is rejected
rules.unclassified_grn: Draft and posting allowed; unclassified units receive standard tags
rules.exact_review_executor: Explicitly extend current catalog review for Finance changes; current UNSPSC-only bundle is insufficient
